conventions.convention: Work over C with N≥2, R_N(x)=xI+iP_N, and rightmost-first composition. Yangian matrix indices run from 1 to N, explicitly reindexing the published zero-based matrix units. RTT is a coefficientwise formal-series identity at infinity.
Evaluation is t_ij(u)=δ_ij I−iρ(E_ij)/(u−a). The dual-natural action is ρ(E_ij)f^k=−δ_ik f^j, giving auxiliary series I+iP_N/(u−a).
On the same ordered tensor space, the stated intertwiner direction is ρ_Δ(t)R_N(a−b)=R_N(a−b)ρ_Δop(t). It is an isomorphism only when a−b≠±i.
The chain has finite length m≥1, arbitrary complex inhomogeneities, dual-natural sites, increasing-site monodromy M_0=L_01⋯L_0m, and ordinary untwisted auxiliary trace.

The Bethe statement requires a common regular pointwise spectral realization of RTT, simultaneous A,D vacuum eigenvalue conditions, u≠v, and B(v)Ω≠0. The equation a(v)=d(v) supplies cancellation without completeness.

load_bearing.statement: For N≥2 over C, the unital associative algebra generated by t_ij^(r), r≥1, is defined by the coefficientwise relation R_12(u−v)T_1(u)T_2(v)=T_2(v)T_1(u)R_12(u−v), with R_N(x)=xI+iP_N.

For N≥2 and all complex a,b,c, writing x=a−b, y=b−c, z=a−c=x+y, R_12(x)R_13(z)R_23(y)=R_23(y)R_13(z)R_12(x). For x≠±i, R_N(x) inverse is (xI−iP_N)/(x²+1). At i the kernel is antisymmetric and rank N(N+1)/2; at −i the kernel is symmetric and rank N(N−1)/2.
For every 1≤i,j,k,l≤N, matrix RTT is equivalent coefficientwise to (u−v)[t_ij(u),t_kl(v)]=i(t_kj(v)t_il(u)−t_kj(u)t_il(v)).

For N≥2, every left gl_N(C)-module W with action ρ and every a∈C, the proposed evaluation assignment extends to a Y_i(gl_N)-representation. The dual-natural action is a gl_N-representation and its unnormalized auxiliary Lax matrix equals R_N(u−a).

The coefficientwise assignments Δ(t_ij(u))=Σ_k t_ik(u)⊗t_kj(u), ε(t_ij(u))=δ_ij, and S(T(u))=T(u) inverse define a coassociative coproduct, counit, and antipode into the ordinary algebraic tensor product.
For the defined finite chain and every u,v∈C, R_00′(u−v)M_0(u)M_0′(v)=M_0′(v)M_0(u)R_00′(u−v).

For every defined finite periodic chain, [τ(u),τ(v)]=0 for every u,v∈C, without genericity conditions on the inhomogeneities; invertibility is used away from u−v=±i and polynomial identity extends the result to all pairs.
